sources.title: flux-dev: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview flux-dev is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer built by black-forest-labs that generates images from text descriptions. The model represents a shift from traditional diffusion approaches toward flow matching, a technique that simplifies the generative process while maintaining high image quality.
